title: Customer-Pay Repairs Service Tiers: Damage Scope, Ceilings and Open Orders per Vehicle
content:
**Estimating standard - Customer-Pay Repairs.** Customer-Pay Repairs are held as one of six service tiers. Each tier takes a defined kind of damage and works within the ceilings below. A ceiling shown as 0 or 0.0 means the tier has no ceiling on that measure; for dents, 0 means not applicable.

## Damage each tier takes

| Rank | Service tier | Damage taken | Panels |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Paintless Dent Repair Service | dents and dings with intact paint, no creases at panel edges | within the tier's panel ceiling |
| 2 | Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | scratches, scuffs and chips through the clear coat, no panel replacement | within the tier's panel ceiling |
| 3 | Bumper Refinish Service | one bumper cover repaired or replaced and refinished, no reinforcement damage | - |
| 4 | Panel Repair Service | non-structural repair or replacement of body panels within the tier's panel and labor ceilings | - |
| 5 | Customer-Pay Collision Service | collision damage of any extent, structural included, paid by the customer | - |
| 6 | Complete Refinish Service | full exterior refinish of an undamaged or previously repaired vehicle | - |

## Ceilings and limits

| Service tier | Most dents per visit | Most panels | Most quoted labor hours | Structural operations may be quoted | Open customer-pay repair orders per vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 15 | 3 | 6.0 | No | 1 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 0 (not applicable) | 2 | 4.0 | No | 1 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 0 (not applicable) | 1 | 8.0 | No | 1 |
| Panel Repair Service | 0 (not applicable) | 3 | 24.0 | No | 1 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no ceiling) | 0.0 (no ceiling) | Yes | 1 |
| Complete Refinish Service | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (no ceiling) | 0.0 (no ceiling) | No | 1 |

## Definitions

- **Most dents per visit**: Most dents taken on one repair order (integer; 0 means not applicable).
- **Most panels**: Most body panels the tier works on (integer; 0 means no ceiling).
- **Most quoted labor hours**: Highest quoted labor hours the tier takes (hours, 1 decimal; 0.0 means no ceiling).
- **Structural operations may be quoted**: Whether structural operations may be quoted (boolean).
- **Open customer-pay repair orders per vehicle**: Customer-pay repair orders one vehicle may have open at once (integer).

## Reading the ceilings

- Customer-Pay Collision Service is the only tier in which structural operations may be quoted.
- Customer-Pay Collision Service and Complete Refinish Service show 0 panels and 0.0 hours: neither has a panel or labor-hour ceiling.
- Hypothetical scope of 3 panels and 5.5 quoted labor hours: within the Paintless Dent Repair Service ceilings (3 panels, 6.0 hours) and within the Panel Repair Service ceilings (3 panels, 24.0 hours); above the Cosmetic Touch-Up Service ceilings (2 panels, 4.0 hours) and above the Bumper Refinish Service panel ceiling (1 panel).
- Hypothetical dent count of 15 on one repair order: at the Paintless Dent Repair Service ceiling of 15 and so within it; 16 dents is above it.
- Every tier allows 1 open customer-pay repair order per vehicle at a time.
